verdict.rationale: Gmail publishes its own first-party REST API reference, with per-method pages such as users.messages/send showing the HTTP endpoint and the resource overview, so there is a browsable reference. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive, has a 'try it' explorer, or offers runnable examples, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at the checked paths. missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable code samples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
